title: Processing a HECM Payout Plan Change onto Monthly Scheduled Payments
content:
When a borrower's signed payout plan change request moves a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan onto a plan with monthly scheduled payments, Cedarline processes the change on the handling date: the committed amount leaves the available line, the new scheduled payment, term and first payment month are recorded, and the plan's plan change fee is charged.

**Which loans.** This rule processes a change only for a loan whose current plan pays no scheduled payments, such as the HECM Line of Credit, so no payment release arises and the whole available line after any release is the loan's available line; a change from a plan that pays scheduled payments needs its payment release booked first and is not processed under this rule.

**Conditions.** The new scheduled payment is fixed only after a signed payout plan change request for the change stands on file for the loan with request status submitted. A plan change is processed only while the loan status is active.

**Effect.** The change sets the first payment month to the month after the handling month, records the committed amount as one line commitment entry, charges the plan change fee to the loan balance, and on success the request status becomes processed.

## Processing the change: `process_payout_plan_change_72a1f37c`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `process_payout_plan_change_72a1f37c` and calls it. One call, dated today, books a line commitment entry taking the stated committed amount out of the available line, records the new payout plan with its monthly scheduled payment, term and first payment month on the loan, charges the plan change processing fee of 20.00 USD to the loan balance, and marks the request processed.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `hecm_loan_id` | Reference number of the HECM loan whose plan changes, as returned by the HECM loan lookup. |
| `hecm_request_id` | Reference number of the borrower's signed payout plan change request on that loan, as returned by the HECM request lookup. |
| `new_plan` | The payout plan recorded on the loan, exactly one of: "HECM Line of Credit" (a change onto it is not processed by this call, which then returns an error and books nothing); "HECM Tenure Payment Plan"; "HECM Term Payment Plan"; "HECM Modified Tenure Plan"; "HECM Modified Term Plan"; "HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement" (never the result of a change; the call then returns an error and books nothing). |
| `committed_amount` | Amount taken out of the available line to fund the payments, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places; stored as given, rounded half up to the cent. |
| `scheduled_payment_amount` | The new monthly scheduled payment, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places; stored as given, rounded half up to the cent. |
| `scheduled_payment_term_months` | Number of monthly payments for a term-based plan, an integer count of months; 0 for a plan that is not term-based. |
| `scheduled_payment_start_period` | First month in which the new payments are disbursed, written as a four-digit year, a hyphen and a two-digit month (for example 2031-04). |

**Return.** A sentence beginning "Plan change processed" gives the commitment entry reference (beginning "hcm_"), the processing fee entry reference (beginning "hpf_"), the request reference, the new payout plan, the committed amount, the monthly payment and the 20.00 USD fee with 2 decimals, the term in months, the first payment month, the effective date (today), and the loan's new available line and new balance; it means every entry is booked and the request is processed. A string beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked, which happens for the two plans named above as not processed here and for a loan whose current plan already pays scheduled payments.
